title: PES 0110 writes a programmable fill with its pattern listed in the header
description: design.export with pesVersion 11 writes a programmable fill region as region type 2 and lists its pattern before the thread table, as PE-DESIGN 11.50 does for the owner's V drawn in Programmable Stitch Creator (crates/openstitch-formats/tests/fixtures/pe11/obj-progfill-owner-v.pes; pattern compat/reference/pes/owner-v.pas, Default Size 7.5 mm): u16 size in 0.01 mm, the polylines in a 1024-unit cell. The design is that file's: a 30 x 20 mm rectangle at (20,20) mm, region programmable fill with owner-v at 7.5 mm, density 4.5, direction 45 degrees, no under sewing, 007 PRUSSIAN BLUE, line running in red.

evidence.note: docs/FILE_FORMATS.md, PES 0110 header: the pattern lists, read from obj-progfill-owner-v and obj-motif-line-owner-v (pes11.rs, programmable_fill_and_motif_patterns_read_from_the_header); engine programmable_fill_writes_its_pattern_into_the_header_list

references.make: Run `stitchtool compat --only pes-0110-programmable-fill` and open target/compat/work/pes-0110-programmable-fill/a.pes in PE-DESIGN 11 (App menu > Open). Expected: a 30 x 20 mm rectangle at (20,20) mm with region Prog. Fill Stitch using the owner's V pattern (the one drawn in Programmable Stitch Creator as owner-v.pas), 7.5 x 7.5 mm, density 4.5, direction 45, under sewing off, 007 PRUSSIAN BLUE, line Running Stitch in red, as the owner's obj-progfill-owner-v.pes. Record in the MANIFEST notes: whether the file opens and with what warning, which pattern the region shows in Sewing Attributes (the V, or another), its size and direction fields, and the status-bar size and stitch count against obj-progfill-owner-v's (30,00 x 20,00 mm, 641 stitches). Then Save As PES, default type (Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 File, #PES0110), unchanged, under the file name given, and record the PE-DESIGN version, the date, the operating system and every setting in compat/reference/MANIFEST.json (see docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md). If PE-DESIGN refuses the file or opens it blank, do not add a file: write what you saw in the notes of docs/COMPATIBILITY_TESTS.md instead.

measurements.evidence: PE-DESIGN 11's Layout & Editing Ver.11.0 file signature
obj-progfill-owner-v.pes: one CEmbLine; the reader parses the whole list
